gloss: to re-cover; to replace (paper, fabric); to re-paper

definitions.gloss: to re-cover; to replace a stretched surface (paper, fabric, leather)
definitions.explanation: To remove an existing paper, cloth, leather, or screen surface and replace it with a fresh one. Common with shoji screens, wallpaper, sofa upholstery, and tatami covers.

examples.japanese: {障子|しょうじ}を{張|は}り{替|か}える。
{壁紙|かべがみ}を{白|しろ}に{張|は}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: We re-papered the walls in white.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}くなったソファのカバーを{張|は}り{替|か}えてもらったら、{新品|しんぴん}のように{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When I had the cover of the old sofa replaced, it looked like new.

notes:
Compound of {張|は}る (to stretch, to put up) + {替|か}える (to exchange, to replace).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The surface being replaced is marked with を; the new material with に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {障子|しょうじ}を{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-paper a shoji screen
- {壁紙|かべがみ}を{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-paper the walls
- {畳|たたみ}の{表|おもて}を{張|は}り{替|か}える: replace the cover of tatami mats
- ソファのカバーを{張|は}り{替|か}える: re-cover a sofa

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貼|は}り{替|か}える: replace something pasted (a sticker, poster) — uses the kanji {貼|は} for sticking
- {取|と}り{替|か}える: to swap; replace (general) — does not imply a stretched surface

NOTE: {張|は}り{替|か}える and {貼|は}り{替|か}える are often confused; for shoji, wallpaper, and tatami, {張|は}り{替|か}える is conventional.
